releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.3.7 (Build 74):
• Liquid Design Evolution: Refined all interfaces so color lives on words, numbers, and glyphs while preserving pure dark liquid glass droplets.
• Professional Apple & Google Calendar Grade System: Month grid with colored date typography, 24-hour Google Calendar timeline with hourly slots and NOW indicator, and Agenda schedule view.
• Header Calendar Quick Popup: Replaced alerts bell with Calendar in the top-right capsule for one-tap daily schedule access.
• Smart Nutrition & Gym Notifications: 30-minute daytime meal logging nudges (muted when meals logged), and twice-daily morning (8:00 AM) and evening (6:00 PM) workout logging reminders.
• Outings Liquid Glass Restyle: Re-themed New Outing modals with translucent liquid glass, high-contrast inputs, and crisp typography.
• Drive Upload Ticker & Reader Polish: Continuous progress percentage counter from 0% to 100% and resized preview images avoiding button collision.
